clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Jen'shan teaches young hunters the ways of the wild. The Darkspear jungle troll trains orc and troll marksmen in tracking, ranged combat, and survival.

Jen'shan trains new hunters in the Valley of Trials. Young orcs and Darkspear trolls come to her with inscribed tablets and parchments that direct them to her. She teaches them archery, marksmanship, and wilderness survival, preparing them for the scorpids and boars on the canyon floor.
